manual_changes.choice: Method-level merge retains room19 loading/data behavior, all three held-peer aura apply sites, wall impact capture/queues, and motion delta hooks. UnitPresentation captureEffects insertion conflict resolved by retaining both source branches.

captureEffects sends confirmed flight.impact or top-level event.impact, gun.impacts native energy deltas, terminal state without a live clip, and same-stamp revisions only when actual point fields change. Switched-away weapons remain while native impact particles still exist.

All newly captured NPC ordinary projectiles, as well as player/special projectiles, use real native display frames. Removed the tentative age*30 plus retroactive endpoint-rescaling path because it could move a displayed projectile backwards at low source FPS. Existing packets with no frames use legacy receive rendering. Endpoints never synthesize hit particles or damage. Added bornAt/stopAt/end/f metadata is informational for frame playback.

Same-sequence full and delta records merge native frame history, reject older source state and ended-to-live reversal. A bounded set of 2048 received projectile IDs permits a previously clip-less lower sequence to be repaired without replaying already consumed IDs. Same-stamp corrections compare visible values, not object identity.

When a dead owner loses RemoteMotion, detach in-flight effects at the last displayed source time and advance a local fallback clock. Impact queue entries share the channel clock so queued impacts do not remain attached to a dead clock. Shared pause shifts fallback clocks; no simulation/damage is run.

UnitPresentation.retainUnsent defaults true for standalone use. GameBridge starts false and forwards presentationNetworkActive. Session assigns it each tick only for an open connected link or hosting with peers, and clears it immediately on stop. Already-ended unsent histories expire after 700 ms offline or 15 s with a consumer; sent terminal histories retain 700 ms; live projectiles are not expired by birth age.

Only the two frozen motion-fast-01 network changes are imported: suppress recipients own snap and suppress duplicate immediate world broadcast for a lone uploading joiner. Local host application and scheduled 50 ms world updates remain. Session additionally contains the explicit ephemeral-history flag wiring above.
